description: Run a quoted review at the level the user chose, ONLY after the user confirmed its price. The price is held; what is charged afterwards is never more. If the session's limit would be passed, nothing runs: ask the user, and use approve_more only if they agree. Then poll get_session_findings.

level.description: The level the user confirmed, one the quote priced.

review_id.description: The review_id of the quote the user confirmed.

name: confirm_review
title: Run a confirmed review
